stops.title: Nhwɛmu no
stops.caption: Nnipa a wɔretwɛn sɛ wɔbɛgye wɔn.
stops.speech: Ɔpene nhwɛmu no kura obiara a wakyerɛw ne din nanso wɔnnyee no ntoo mu. Kɔsɛ wɔgye no, ɔntumi nhyɛ mu.

stops.title: Gye obi to mu
stops.caption: Hwɛ asɔre baa no, na gye no.
stops.speech: Hwɛ asɔre baa a wayi ne nsɛm a ɔde maeɛ, na gye no to mu. Ɔbɛtumi ahyɛ mu firi saa berɛ no.
